subject: Running a massive number of inla instances in parallel on the cloud

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Running a massive number of inla instances in parallel on the cloud
parts:
Hi,

I would like to run many (thousands) of inla models using the 'parallel' package in R. So, my code looks like this:

library(parallel)
options(mc.cores = 8)

#Function to fit my models with INLA
fit.inla <- function(...) {...}

#Number of models to fit
N <- 2000
results <- mclapply(1:N, fit.inla, ...)


So far I am using my university cluster but this only allows me to use 8 cores. Has anybody on this list used Amazon cloud or a similar cloud system to run many inla models in parallel? If so, I'd appreciate if they could comment on the list. I am particularly interested in something which is easy to set-up, can run hundreds of inla models in parallel and it is 'affordable'. 

Many thanks,

Virgilio
